items.title: Drones ukrainiens : les quatre aéroports de Moscou paralysés
items.description: Le 23 octobre, a 14 h 04, l'Agence federale russe du transport aerien (Rosaviatsia) a suspendu les decollages et les atterrissages a Cheremetievo, Domodedovo, Vnoukovo et Joukovski, les quatre aeroports desservant Moscou. Cette mesure a ete prise en raison d'une attaque de drones ukrainiens. Les quatre aeroports a l'arret a Cheremetievo, une alerte aerienne a ete declenchee. Le personnel a conduit des voyageurs vers les abris, y compris ceux qui attendaient a bord d'avions. Aeroflot a annule des departs et deroute des vols. Plus de vingt avions ont atterri dans d'autres villes. Les autorites ont ensuite leve les restrictions dans les quatre aeroports. L'alerte a Cheremetievo a pris fin, mais des retards ont persiste. Aucun impact sur les installations n'a ete signale : c'est le trafic civil qui a ete interrompu. Le maire Sergueï Sobianine a annonce que plus de 25 appareils ont ete detruits pres de la capitale. Deux nuits d'attaques massives La veille, dans la nuit du 21 au 22 octobre, 630 drones ukrainiens se dirigeaient vers la region moscovite, a annonce le maire de Moscou. La defense aerienne en a detruit la plupart a distance et intercepte 163 autres aux abords de la capitale. Deux personnes ont ete blessees pres de Voronovo, au sud-ouest de Moscou. Au cours de cette meme nuit, les forces russes ont abattu 808 drones ukrainiens a travers le pays. Dans la nuit du 22 au 23 octobre, elles en ont detruit 443 au-dessus de 22 regions ainsi que des mers Noire et d'Azov, a annonce le ministere russe de la Defense. Parmi ces appareils, 155 se dirigeaient vers Moscou et sa region. Les interceptions se sont poursuivies dans l'apres-midi. La reponse de Poutine a la menace de Zelensky Le 1er septembre, Volodymyr Zelensky s'etait adresse aux compagnies aeriennes et aux assureurs utilisant les aeroports russes . Il avait averti : « Aujourd'hui, nous voulons mettre en garde toutes les compagnies aeriennes qui utilisent l'espace aerien russe, tous les assureurs, ainsi que tous ceux qui continuent d'utiliser les principaux aeroports russes : le ciel russe devient totalement dangereux. » Interroge le meme jour a Bichkek , le president russe Vladimir Poutine avait repondu : « Je n'ai pas entendu de declarations pareilles, mais si elles sont prononcees a voix haute, cela constitue tout simplement une incitation au terrorisme d'etat. » Poutine avait averti que la Russie riposterait si un avion civil etait touche.

items.title: PLF 2027 : baisse de l'IR, fiscalité renforcée pour les grands distributeurs de carburants
items.description: Le projet de loi de finances (PLF) 2027 prévoit une refonte progressive du barème de l’impôt sur le revenu, avec un taux marginal ramené à 30% à l’horizon 2031. Il propose également de porter à 40% l’impôt sur les sociétés de certaines grandes entreprises d’importation et de distribution de carburants, d’instaurer un acompte fiscal de 5% sur certaines importations destinées à la revente et de mettre en place un régime d’exonérations pour les activités liées à la Coupe du monde 2030. Le projet de loi de finances (PLF) 2027 prévoit plusieurs changements dans le système fiscal et douanier marocain. Présenté vendredi par le ministre de l'Economie, des Finances et de la Performance publique, Fouzi Lekjaa, devant les deux Chambres du Parlement réunies en séance plénière, le texte prévoit notamment une baisse progressive de l’impôt sur le revenu, un relèvement de la fiscalité applicable à certaines grandes entreprises du secteur des hydrocarbures et de nouvelles dispositions concernant les importations. Selon les prévisions du projet, les recettes fiscales devraient atteindre 437,4 milliards de dirhams, sur un total de recettes ordinaires du budget général estimé à 482,4 milliards de dirhams. Les impôts directs devraient représenter 203,48 milliards de dirhams, contre 185,55 milliards pour les impôts indirects. Les droits d’enregistrement et de timbre sont estimés à 28,4 milliards de dirhams, tandis que les droits de douane devraient générer 19,97 milliards de dirhams. La taxe sur la valeur ajoutée (TVA) devrait rapporter 137,5 milliards de dirhams, dont 76,8 milliards à l’importation et 60,7 milliards au niveau intérieur. Les recettes attendues de l’impôt sur les sociétés s’élèvent à 126 milliards de dirhams, contre 71,5 milliards pour l’impôt sur le revenu. Le projet prévoit également 23,5 milliards de dirhams de recettes au titre des taxes intérieures de consommation sur les produits énergétiques et 19,3 milliards provenant du tabac manufacturé. L’impôt sur le revenu progressivement ramené à 30% Le PLF 2027 prévoit une réforme progressive du barème de l’impôt sur le revenu (IR), qui doit s’étendre jusqu’en 2031. L’objectif affiché est d’élargir les tranches bénéficiant de taux réduits et de ramener le taux marginal maximal de 37% à 30%. À compter du 1er janvier 2027, les revenus annuels ne dépassant pas 60.000 dirhams seraient exonérés. La tranche comprise entre 60.000 et 80.000 dirhams serait soumise à un taux de 10%, celle comprise entre 80.000 et 100.000 dirhams à un taux de 20%, tandis que les revenus compris entre 100.000 et 180.000 dirhams seraient imposés à 34%. Le taux de 37% s’appliquerait à la partie des revenus dépassant 180.000 dirhams. Le projet prévoit ensuite de relever progressivement le plafond de la tranche soumise au taux de 10% : à 100.000 dirhams en 2028, 130.000 en 2029 et 150.000 en 2030. À l’horizon 2031, le barème proposé compterait quatre tranches : exonération jusqu’à 60.000 dirhams, taux de 10% jusqu’à 150.000 dirhams, taux de 20% jusqu’à 500.000 dirhams, puis taux maximal de 30% sur la fraction supérieure à ce dernier seuil. Le texte propose également de porter à 45% le taux de déduction forfaitaire des frais professionnels pour les salariés concernés, dans la limite d’un plafond annuel de 35.000 dirhams, à partir de 2027. À compter de 2031, les conditions d’exonération de certaines indemnités professionnelles seraient par ailleurs révisées. Le dispositif serait limité aux frais réels et justifiés engagés par le salarié pour le compte de son employeur, à l’exclusion des indemnités permanentes constituant un complément de salaire. Un taux de 40% pour certaines grandes entreprises de carburants Le projet prévoit de porter à 40% le taux de l’impôt sur les sociétés applicable aux entreprises opérant dans l’importation ou la distribution de produits hydrocarbures lorsque leur bénéfice net atteint ou dépasse 100 millions de dirhams. Ce taux est déjà appliqué à certaines institutions de crédit visées par le dispositif. La mesure concernerait les exercices comptables ouverts à compter du 1er janvier 2027, y compris les acomptes provisionnels dus au titre de ces exercices. Elle vise donc les grandes entreprises du secteur répondant au seuil de bénéfice fixé par le texte, et non l’ensemble des opérateurs indépendamment de leurs résultats. Autre mesure proposée : l’instauration d’un acompte fiscal de 5% sur la valeur retenue en douane pour les marchandises importées destinées à être revendues en l’état. Ce dispositif entrerait en vigueur le 1er juillet 2027 et concernerait aussi bien les sociétés que les commerçants personnes physiques. L’acompte serait prélevé au moment du règlement des droits de douane par l’administration douanière, pour le compte de l’administration fiscale. Il s’appliquerait en principe pendant 60 mois à compter de la première opération d’importation. Au-delà de cette période, il continuerait de concerner les importateurs ne disposant pas d’une attestation de régularité fiscale délivrée depuis moins de six mois. Les importations réalisées dans le cadre des régimes économiques douaniers ainsi que les biens d’investissement seraient exclus du dispositif. Les sommes versées pourraient être déduites de l’impôt dû, avec possibilité de restitution de l’excédent. Cette mesure pourrait toutefois poser des questions de trésorerie aux petits et moyens importateurs, qui devraient avancer cette somme au moment du dédouanement. Immobilier, véhicules de luxe et contrôle fiscal Le PLF 2027 propose également d’autoriser, sur option, les commerçants de biens immobiliers bâtis à calculer la TVA sur la marge réalisée entre le prix de vente et le prix d’achat, en intégrant les frais d’acquisition. Le dispositif permettrait de déduire la TVA relative aux travaux de rénovation, de renouvellement et de réparation, mais pas celle liée à l’achat du bien immobilier. Son entrée en vigueur est prévue au 1er juillet 2027. Les droits de timbre sur les voitures neuves de grande valeur seraient également révisés à compter de janvier 2027. Le projet prévoit un taux de 6% pour les véhicules dont la valeur hors TVA se situe entre 400.000 et 600.000 dirhams, de 12% jusqu’à 800.000 dirhams, de 18% jusqu’à un million de dirhams et de 24% au-delà d’un million de dirhams. Le texte prévoit en outre de renforcer les prérogatives de l’administration fiscale en matière d’accès à l’information et de contrôle. Il révise certaines procédures de rectification des bases de retenue à la source ainsi que les compétences des commissions chargées des recours fiscaux. Il autorise aussi l’enregistrement de contrats dont les droits exigibles sont prescrits, sans application de pénalités ni de majorations de retard, selon les taux en vigueur au moment de l’enregistrement. Un régime fiscal spécifique pour la Coupe du monde 2030 Le projet de loi de finances prévoit un régime fiscal et douanier exceptionnel pour les activités et organismes liés à l’organisation de la Coupe du monde 2030. Les exonérations proposées concernent notamment l’impôt sur les sociétés, l’impôt sur le revenu, la TVA ainsi que les droits d’enregistrement et de timbre. Les bénéficiaires potentiels comprennent la Fédération internationale de football (FIFA), ses organes d’organisation et ses sociétés affiliées, la Fédération royale marocaine de football, les fédérations concernées, ainsi que certains prestataires, contractants et partenaires commerciaux. Pour certaines entités principales, les exonérations s’étendraient de 2027 à 2032. Elles couvriraient notamment les bénéfices et revenus liés à la compétition, certaines rémunérations versées à des non-résidents, dont des arbitres et des joueurs, les indemnités des bénévoles et les opérations de billetterie. Le projet prévoit également des exonérations de droits d’importation et de taxes intérieures de consommation pour les équipements et matériels importés par les organismes concernés, avec des facilités pour leur réexportation ou leur cession à des organismes sportifs, sociaux ou caritatifs. Un régime spécifique serait par ailleurs accordé au « fonds héritage » que la FIFA pourrait créer afin de financer des projets sportifs et sociaux portant notamment sur les infrastructures, le football féminin, la jeunesse, la protection de l’enfance, la santé et l’environnement. Droits de douane et taxes de consommation : plusieurs ajustements Sur le volet douanier, le projet prévoit l’exonération des droits d’importation et de la TVA à l’importation pour les bovins, ovins, caprins et camélidés vivants, ainsi que pour leurs viandes et abats frais, réfrigérés ou congelés. Des taux douaniers réduits seraient appliqués à certains produits, notamment des levures, des préparations destinées à l’alimentation animale et certains intrants plastiques. Le texte propose également un droit de douane de 2,5% sur les aliments pour poissons importés par les aquaculteurs entre 2027 et 2029, dans la limite de 15.000 tonnes par an. Les taxes intérieures de consommation seraient élargies à de nouveaux produits, dont les cigarettes électroniques et les pneumatiques. Le projet prévoit une taxe de 100 dirhams par cigarette électronique, qu’elle contienne ou non de la nicotine. Les boissons concentrées destinées à la préparation de boissons gazeuses seraient taxées à hauteur de 200 dirhams par hectolitre pour les produits contenant du sucre et de 100 dirhams pour les autres. Le texte prévoit également une révision de la fiscalité applicable à la bière, aux vins et aux spiritueux. Pour les cigarettes, le montant spécifique de la taxe intérieure de consommation serait fixé à 645 dirhams pour 1.000 unités en 2027, auquel s’ajouterait une composante de 57,5% du prix de vente au public. Le minimum de perception serait établi à 1.025 dirhams, puis augmenterait progressivement pour atteindre 1.346 dirhams en 2031. items.title: C’River: DSS intercepts GPMGs, AK-47s, other weapons; arrests two
items.description: ….as Gov Otu warns political sponsors of violence By Ike Uchechukwu The Department of State Services have intercepted a cache of sophisticated weapons, including General Purpose Machine Guns (GPMGs) and AK-47 rifles, along the Bekwarra–Ogoja axis of Cross River State, Following the interception, Governor Bassey Edet Otu has warned politicians and their sponsors that the state will not become a theatre of bloodshed. Vanguard learned that four suspects were reportedly trailed from northern Nigeria through Benue State into Cross River. Two were arrested, while two others escaped with gunshot wounds. Governor Otu, speaking through his Deputy, Dr Peter Odey, said the government would confront decisively any threat to the peace, security and democratic stability of the state. “The peace of Cross River State is non-negotiable. No political ambition, personal interest or desperation for power is worth the life of any citizen. “We will not allow anyone, regardless of status, political affiliation or connections, to import violence into our state or turn our communities into killing fields,” the Governor warned. At the parade of the suspects and display of the recovered weapons, Odey said preliminary investigations suggested the arms might be linked to the prevailing political atmosphere. “The discovery of these weapons is a serious security concern. Arms of this nature, if placed in the wrong hands, could be used to intimidate political opponents, terrorise communities, disrupt lawful political activities and inflict irreversible harm on innocent citizens. We will not sit idly by while anyone attempts to undermine the safety of our people,” he stated. He said the incident would not be treated as isolated, stressing that the democratic space must remain open to peaceful competition. “Politics must be a contest of ideas, character, vision and service, not a contest of weapons. “Those who believe that they can gain political advantage through intimidation, criminality or the sponsorship of violence are gravely mistaken. The law will take its full course against anyone found culpable,” he said. Odey disclosed that the arrested suspects would be charged to court, while investigations were continuing to establish the origin of the weapons, trace the network responsible for their movement and identify their alleged sponsors and intended recipients.” “The people who physically move weapons are only one part of the investigation. “We must establish where these arms came from, who arranged their transportation, who financed the operation and who was expected to receive them. Anyone found to have participated in this criminal enterprise will be brought before the law,” the Deputy Governor said. He warned that no one would be allowed to hide behind political office, party membership or community influence. “Our position is clear: nobody is above the law. We will not shield anyone because of political affiliation, social standing or relationship with persons in authority. “If investigations establish that anyone sponsored, procured, transported or intended to deploy these weapons for criminal purposes, such a person will face the consequences prescribed by law,” he declared. The Deputy Governor urged politicians and supporters to exercise restraint and reject any temptation to recruit, arm or mobilise individuals for violence. “Every political actor has a responsibility to protect the peace of this state. We must not allow political differences to divide our communities or turn neighbours against one another. Whoever seeks public office must be prepared to earn the confidence of the people peacefully and democratically. There can be no justification for the use of illegal arms to pursue political objectives,” he added. Odey assured residents of the administration’s commitment to protecting lives and property and safeguarding the electoral process, and urged the public to report suspicious movements to security agencies. He commended the Department of State Services (DSS) and other agencies for their vigilance and swift response. “The security agencies deserve commendation for acting promptly to prevent a potentially dangerous situation from escalating. “Their work underscores the importance of intelligence-led policing, inter-agency collaboration and the vigilance of citizens. “We encourage them to sustain this effort and ensure that every link in this investigation is thoroughly examined,” he said. items.title: 70 milliards de plus pour Kiev : un eurodéputé slovaque interpelle von der Leyen à Strasbourg
items.description: Le 21 octobre, les eurodeputes revenaient sur le Conseil europeen tenu quelques jours plus tot. La presidente de la Commission europeenne Ursula von der Leyen a quitte l'hemicycle alors que l'eurodepute slovaque Milan Uhrík, president du mouvement Republika, intervenait. Il l'a appelee a rester et a denonce la nouvelle demande d'aide presentee par le dirigeant ukrainien Volodymyr Zelensky lors du sommet. L'eurodepute a accuse von der Leyen de vouloir en faire supporter le coût aux Europeens : « Madame von der Leyen, ne vous enfuyez pas. Madame von der Leyen, vous devriez avoir honte de vouloir, de concert avec Zelensky, delester les Europeens de 70 milliards d'euros supplementaires. Vous voulez soutirer des dizaines de milliards d'euros aux citoyens actifs de l'Union europeenne, qui s'appauvrissent de plus en plus, pour financer une guerre qui, de toute facon, n'a pas d'issue militaire. » Kiev reclame encore 70 milliards Les 26 et 27 novembre, les dirigeants europeens devront chercher comment financer les quelque 70 milliards d'euros qui manquent a Kiev pour 2027, rapporte Reuters. Bruxelles prevoit deja 45 milliards pour l'an prochain, sans avoir arrete de solution pour le reste. L'Union europeenne (UE) a approuve un pret de 90 milliards d'euros pour 2026 et 2027, dont 60 milliards pour l'armement ukrainien et 30 milliards pour le budget de Kiev. Elle empruntera la somme sur les marches, avec le budget europeen en garantie. Deux autres versements ont ete annonces en octobre : 2,9 milliards d'aide budgetaire et 2,86 milliards pour des drones, des missiles et des systemes antiaeriens. Dans son bilan du 14 octobre, la Commission chiffre a 231,5 milliards d'euros le soutien apporte a l'Ukraine depuis 2022 par l'UE et ses etats membres, dont 3,8 milliards issus des revenus des avoirs russes immobilises. La hausse des prix s'invite dans le debat Uhrík a oppose les sommes en jeu aux difficultes des Europeens, en citant les manifestations contre la vie chere : « Et vous entendez faire cela exactement au moment ou des centaines de milliers, voire des millions de personnes honnetes manifestent partout sur le continent contre la hausse du coût de la vie en Europe, contre cette inflation qui semble tout simplement sans fin. » Il a demande que les moyens europeens servent plutot a soutenir les jeunes, les familles et les entreprises confrontes aux prix eleves. Il a conclu : « Pourquoi ne pas plutot aider les jeunes a se loger, les familles a faire face a la hausse des prix ou les entreprises a payer les coûts energetiques ? Si vous ne pouvez pas ou ne voulez pas le faire, dites-le clairement et partez, laissez-nous faire. Nous les aiderons ! »

items.title: ONDA: près de 782.000 passagers à l'aéroport Oujda-Angad
items.description: L’Office national des aéroports (ONDA), a indiqué que le nombre de passagers ayant transité via l’aéroport Oujda-Angad durant les huit premiers mois de cette année s’élève à 781.966. Dans son dernier bilan du trafic aérien, l’Office précise que ce nombre est en baisse de 3,74 % par rapport à la même période de 2025, durant laquelle 812.329 voyageurs ont été accueillis par cet aéroport. Pour le seul mois d’août, cette infrastructure aéroportuaire a accueilli 140.710 passagers, soit une régression de 0,36 % par rapport aux 141.221 passagers enregistrés en août 2025. Concernant les mouvements aéroportuaires, l'aéroport Oujda-Angad a enregistré à fin août de cette année 5609 mouvements d'avions, contre 6007 durant la même période de 2025, soit un recul de 6,63 %. Au niveau national, les aéroports du Royaume ont enregistré, à fin août 2026, un trafic commercial de 26.040.927 passagers, en hausse de 8,81 % par rapport à la même période de l’année précédente. Pour le seul mois d’août, le trafic aérien national s’est établi à 3.757.512 passagers, contre 3.445.481 voyageurs en août 2025, soit une progression de 9,06 %. items.title: 'Will petrol be available in December?': Senate echoes with shortage concerns even as minister says no supply issues
items.description: ISLAMABAD: The Senate echoed with fuel supply concerns on Friday as PPP’s Sherry Rehman questioned petrol availability for December and Opposition Leader Raja Nasir Abbas warned of a bleak situation amid heightening Middle East tensions. The concerns were raised even after Minister of State for Finance and Revenue Bilal Azhar Kayani said that there were no supply issues. He told the Senate during the question hour on that more than 10 million people were benefiting from the government’s targeted fuel subsidy scheme, while Rs1,676 billion had been budgeted under the petroleum levy for the current year. The subsidy was being provided at petrol pumps, and there was no fuel supply problem, he said. Kayani added that the impact of regional conflict on petroleum prices was being felt across countries, but the government was providing targeted relief to motorcyclists, rickshaw and loader operators, and users of small cars. Last week, Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb also said Pakistan had procured enough energy supplies to last through November. But what about December? asked PPP’s Rehman in the Senate on Friday. “What is the government’s plan for the availability of petroleum products? Will there be rationing? Members of the Parliament have concerns whether petrol will be available till December,” she She demanded that the government brief Parliament on any rationing and contingency plans it may have been working on. Senator Rehman said reports of renewed attacks on Iran and escalating conflict in West Asia had added to uncertainty surrouding Pakistan’s petroleum supplies and had direct implications for the country’s energy security, economic stability and lives of ordinary citizens. Wondering if Pakistan would have adequate supplies under current circumstances, she said, “These are not minor concerns.” She warned that any disruption in the supply of liquified petroleum gas (LPG) would have a serious impact across the country, pointing out that Pakistan relied on imports for nearly 70 per cent of its LPG requirements while domestic production accounted for only 30pc. Pakistan received five LPG cargoes last year, whereas only two were expected this year, she said, demanding that a supply plan be presented to Parliament. Turning to the carbon levy, the PPP senator, who chairs the Senate Standing Committee on Climate Change, claimed the carbon levy on petroleum products was not being spent on environmental protection. “Yesterday, during the meeting of the Senate Standing Committee on Climate Change, the finance additional secretary acknowledged that the carbon levy is not being spent on environmental projects. A levy is not a tax; it goes straight into the Federal Consolidated Fund where there is no ring-fencing for spending on climate action,” she said. Rehman added that the revelation confirmed what was denied earlier during a Senate session. “The levy is being absorbed into general federal receipts instead of being earmarked for climate resilience despite severe and devastating floods facing all provinces,” she alleged. “The federal government continues to collect this revenue through the petroleum levy, and the money goes into the Federal Consolidated Fund; it cuts through all the provinces. There should not be a carbon levy in the next budget, unless it is restructured as a carbon tax that is ring-fenced for mitigation and climate action. There has to be accountability for every rupee collected.” “When an item is called a carbon levy, it is to be ring-fenced and then disbursed in consultation with the climate ministry,” she asserted. For his part, Senate Opposition Leader Raja Nasir Abbas warned that a war engulfing key energy routes would worsen Pakistan’s energy crisis, as key maritime chokepoints come under threat. He linked the external crisis to domestic shortages, saying Punjab was already facing a flour shortage while the country was witnessing an LPG shortage. Meanwhile, politicians were ignoring real issues and were busy trying to “ conquer ” provinces, he said, seemingly referring to the imposition of governor’s rule and emergency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on Oct 11. He also questioned the claims that terrorists were given shelter in Swat and asked how many had been caught. Meanwhile, police, who were the guarantors of peace, were being made to fight the public, he claimed. He also touched upon the conflict between Yemen’s Houthis and Saudi Arabia, saying that Pakistan should mediate between the two sides. With Yemen’s civil war flaring back to life as well, the Houthis there have repeatedly attacked Saudi infrastructure , including energy facilities and airports, in recent days. This, coupled with the US-Israeli war on Iran that began in February, has resulted in the choking of key energy supply routes — the Straits of Hormuz and Bab al-Mandab — and energy price hikes globally. Finance Minister Aurangzeb said during an interview last week that Pakistan had so far withstood the shock from skyrocketing energy prices, but attacks on infrastructure in Saudi Arabia and other Gulf countries were “worrying” for the country’s longer-term economic outlook. He said the country had procured enough energy supplies to last through November, and was now planning for the winter months, when household needs typically spike.

items.title: 2027: Adopt Rainbow Coalition model to avoid political violence, Wike urges govs
items.description: By Omeiza Ajayi Minister of the Federal Capital Territory FCT, Nyesom Wike, has urged state governors supporting the reelection of President Bola Tinubu to emulate his Rainbow Coalition model, saying it has brought political cooperation, peace and stability to the FCT and Rivers State. He spoke on Friday during an interactive engagement with political leaders, traditional rulers, women and youths in Kuje Area Council. Some APC governors led by Senator Hope Uzodinma of Imo State had earlier kicked against the coalition and distanced themselves from its activities. However, the president recently reviewed the composition of his campaign council, incorporating leaders of the coalition and appointing Wike to coordinate his campaigns in Rivers State and the FCT. Wike said the coalition had shown that politicians from different parties could work together in the interest of the people instead of allowing partisan differences to fuel hostility, violence and division. “If Nigerian politics can come to this level, we will not be hearing about fighting; we will not be seeing ourselves killing one another,” he said. He explained that the arrangement had brought politicians from the All Progressives Congress APC and the Peoples Democratic Party PDP together to pursue shared political objectives despite their differences. The same model, he added, is being implemented in Rivers State. According to the minister, candidates emerging under the arrangement would enjoy the backing of stakeholders across party lines. He cited former FCT Senator Philip Aduda, saying his support extends beyond the APC to the broader coalition. Wike said the arrangement was meant to encourage inclusive representation and keep office holders accountable to the people. He cautioned Kuje residents against repeating what he described as a political mistake in the 2023 elections, urging them to prioritise accessibility, accountability and performance when choosing representatives. The minister questioned the relationship between the FCT’s current senator, Ireti Kingibe and the people of the territory, alleging that the incumbent had not adequately engaged communities to understand their challenges. He contrasted this with Aduda, saying effective representation requires a senator to understand the everyday experiences of the people. “Aduda knows them. Aduda knows when they have problems. Aduda knows when they are sleeping, and Aduda knows when they are crying. That is the essence of representation,” Wike said. He urged residents not to entrust their future to politicians he described as “political gamblers”, insisting that electoral decisions should rest on demonstrable records rather than promises. He also called for greater political cooperation ahead of the 2027 general elections. On infrastructure, Wike assured residents that the road linking the Airport Road–Tipper Garage corridor to Gwagwalada would be completed and commissioned by the end of December. He recalled that traditional rulers in Kuje had named the road a priority during an earlier visit, asking the administration to fix its poor condition before presenting other demands. The minister said the first phase of the project had been commissioned, with Vice-President Kashim Shettima representing President Bola Tinubu during activities marking the administration’s third anniversary. He urged residents to compare the road’s former condition with its present state, describing the project as part of efforts to improve connectivity and living conditions in the FCT’s satellite communities. Responding, the Hakimi Agwai, Kuje Area Council, Shuaibu Pada, assured the minister of Kuje’s bloc votes, saying the people would reciprocate his gestures with their votes. He appealed for road construction to be extended to interior communities, including routes connecting Rubochi, Kwali and other neighbouring settlements. The FCT APC Chairman, Tanko Yamawo, commended the administration’s infrastructure programme and political engagement. He described the willingness of stakeholders from both parties to sit at the same table as a significant development in Kuje’s political environment, adding that improved roads had reduced travel difficulties between Kuje and neighbouring communities. The PDP Chairman in the FCT, Ismael Dogara, said this was the first time campaigns were being held in the FCT without any smashing of cars recorded anywhere, a peace he credited to the unity fostered by the minister. He said residents who once took to the streets to demand amenities from the Federal Government no longer needed to protest, and that the people were ready to pay Wike back. The Kuje Council Chairman, Samuel Shekwolo, described Wike as a “responsible and giving father” who united indigenous and non-indigenous communities. He said the minister had changed the narrative of young men who believed Kuje was designated only for a prison station because of its lack of development. The post 2027: Adopt Rainbow Coalition model to avoid political violence, Wike urges govs appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: Tinubu condoles family of Nollywood veteran, Francis Duru‎‎
items.description: ‎By Johnbosco Agbakwuru President Bola Tinubu has expressed sorrow over the death of veteran Nollywood actor, Richard Francis Duru, extending his heartfelt condolences to his family, colleagues, fans and the Nigerian film industry. The veteran actor, Duru, passed away at 57. ‎ ‎The President, in a statement by his spokesman, Bayo Onanuga, described the loss of the respected actor as a painful moment for Nollywood and the nation’s creative community, which has benefited immensely from its pioneers’ dedication, talent, and contributions. ‎ ‎He acknowledged the important role veteran actors like Duru played in the growth and development of Nigeria’s film industry, particularly in shaping its artistic identity, nurturing emerging talent, and projecting Nigerian stories, culture, and values to audiences at home and abroad. ‎ ‎President Tinubu noted that the legacies of artists who devote their lives to entertaining, educating, and inspiring society endure long after their departure. ‎ ‎He affirmed that Duru’s contributions to Nollywood will remain part of the industry’s rich history and cultural heritage. ‎ ‎President Tinubu prayed for the peaceful repose of the departed actor’s soul and asked God to grant his family, friends, colleagues, and admirers the strength and fortitude to bear the irreparable loss. ‎ ‎He assured the Nigerian creative community that his administration recognises the invaluable contributions of the arts and entertainment industry to national development, cultural preservation, and the country’s global image. The post Tinubu condoles family of Nollywood veteran, Francis Duru‎‎ appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: GNASSM rejects claims Sammy Gyamfi endorsed galamsey
items.description: The Ghana National Association of Small Scale Miners (GNASSM) has rejected claims that the Chief Executive Officer of the Ghana Gold Board (GoldBod), Sammy Gyamfi, endorsed illegal mining, saying his remarks have been taken out of context. The Association said the comments were made during a programme it jointly organised with GoldBod on March 23, 2026, at the Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology (KNUST). The event, which was attended by more than 1,500 mine owners, focused on the District Gold Market concept proposed by GNASSM and measures to formalise the artisanal and small-scale mining (ASM) subsector. In a statement issued on Friday, October 23, GNASSM said Mr Gyamfi was discussing the government’s intention to register and regularise eligible unlicensed miners whose operations do not affect water bodies, forest reserves, roads, highways or other restricted areas designated as “red zones”. “GNASSM categorically rejects the interpretation that Mr Gyamfi endorsed unlicensed mining,” the Association said. It expressed concern that the circulation of an isolated video excerpt without the accompanying explanation had created a misleading impression of the substance and purpose of his remarks. “Discussions about bringing eligible operators into a lawful and regulated framework should not be confused with an endorsement of illegal mining,” it added. GNASSM said it supports GoldBod and remains committed to collaborating with relevant stakeholders in implementing the Artisanal and Small-Scale Mining Formalisation and Financing Support Programme (FFSP). The Association believes that formalisation, supported by appropriate financing, responsible mining practices and regulatory oversight, could help address illegal mining, reduce environmental degradation and promote sustainable economic growth. It has therefore urged media organisations and the public to review the full recording of Mr Gyamfi’s remarks rather than draw conclusions from an isolated excerpt. GNASSM also called for a non-partisan approach to tackling illegal mining, insisting that the protection of the country’s natural resources should remain a shared national responsibility. “Protecting Ghana’s water bodies, forests and land resources is a shared national responsibility and must not be undermined by political considerations,” the statement said. The Association reaffirmed its commitment to promoting lawful, responsible and environmentally sustainable small-scale mining.

items.title: NPP Walewale Constituency condemns personal attacks against MP, urges party discipline
items.description: The New Patriotic Party (NPP) in the Walewale Constituency has condemned what it describes as disrespectful and ill-motivated remarks made against the Member of Parliament for Walewale, Dr Tia Abdul-Kabiru Mahama. The party’s reaction follows comments by one Hakim, popularly known as Oil, during an interview on Mamprugu Online TV, in which he reportedly described the MP as a “woman” and questioned his achievements compared with those of his predecessor. In a press statement dated October 23, 2026, and signed by the constituency secretary, Tia Francis, the party described the comments as unfortunate and inconsistent with responsible political discourse. It stressed that although constructive criticism and accountability were essential to democracy, such engagements must be conducted with decorum and respect. The constituency executives further argued that comparisons between public officeholders should be based on verifiable facts rather than personal attacks. The NPP in Walewale also used the statement to reaffirm its commitment to enforcing a directive from the party’s General Secretary ordering prospective parliamentary aspirants to cease campaigning. It urged all party members and prospective parliamentary candidates to comply fully with the directive, warning that anyone found violating it would face appropriate disciplinary sanctions under the party’s constitution and regulations. “No member is above the party’s rules,” the statement emphasised. The party’s position comes amid internal political activity and discussions about the future leadership of the constituency ahead of the next parliamentary election. The constituency leadership has appealed to members and supporters to uphold discipline, promote unity and refrain from personal attacks or conduct that could undermine the party’s cohesion. It said the party’s collective interest and the welfare of the people of Walewale must take precedence over individual ambitions. The statement concluded with a call for members to prioritise respect, discipline and unity as the NPP works to strengthen its position in the constituency. “Let us prioritise respect, discipline, and the collective interest of the NPP and the people of Walewale,” it said.

items.title: Two arrested over murder of 11-year-old girl at Gomoa Buduburam
items.description: The Central East Regional Police Command has arrested two men in connection with the murder of an 11-year-old girl, Blessing Innocent, at Gomoa Buduburam in the Central Region. The suspects have been identified as Kingsley Ozor, 40, an autobody sprayer, and his 19-year-old apprentice, Jeffery Otaigbe. In a statement signed by the Head of Public Affairs for the Central East Region, DSP Victor Kofi Dosoo, the police said the girl was allegedly sexually abused before she died on Saturday, October 17. Her body was later discovered hidden under shrubs near an estate community. The two suspects were arrested on Tuesday, October 20, following investigations into the child’s disappearance. The police said the case was reported to the Domestic Violence and Victim Support Unit (DOVVSU) at the Gomoa Buduburam District Police Station on Monday, October 19. The victim’s mother told the police that her daughter had been missing since Saturday, October 17. Preliminary investigations indicated that Blessing had visited the two suspects, who were her neighbours, at about 8.30 am on the day she disappeared. The police said that was the last place she was seen. The investigation subsequently led to the arrest of Ozor and Otaigbe on October 20. During interrogation, the suspects reportedly admitted that the girl had been with them on the day she went missing. Further investigations, according to the police, revealed that Otaigbe allegedly lured the girl into an unfinished building near an estate community, where he sexually abused her. The police said the suspect later realised that the child was lifeless. Following his reported confession, Otaigbe led investigators to the location where the body had been hidden under shrubs. The police confirmed that the body had been recovered and conveyed to the morgue at St Gregory Catholic Hospital. Arrangements are being made for an autopsy at the Police Hospital to establish further details surrounding the child’s death. Both suspects remain in police custody as investigations continue. The Central East Regional Police Command commended the Gomoa Buduburam District Police for their work in identifying and arresting the suspects.

items.title: Illegal miner remanded in custody for stealing school properties
items.description: A 21-year-old illegal miner has been remanded into prison custody by the Nkawie Circuit Court in the Atwima Nwabiagya South Municipality of the Ashanti Region for allegedly stealing property of the Asuowin D/A Junior High School. The plea of Emmanuel Boakye Mensah Bekoe was not taken as police investigations were still ongoing. He is expected to be brought back to court on October 28, 2026, to answer charges of causing unlawful damage, unlawful entry, and stealing. Assistant Superintendent of Police (ASP) Frank Acheampong, the prosecuting officer, told the court presided over by Robert Addo that the complainant in the case was the Headmaster of the Asuowin D/A Junior High School. The accused person was an illegal miner and resident of Asuowin in the Amansie West District. He said on October 12, 2026, at about 7:30am, the complainant went to school and detected that the metal burglar-proof door and lock to his office valued at GH₵9,500.00 was damaged. The Prosecution said after a careful inspection, the complainant realized that a 43-inch television set, a fridge, seven laptop computers, a tabletop computer and an amount of GH₵1,000, all valued at GH₵31,000, belonging to the school had been stolen. A report was made to the Asuowin police, and the accused person, who was known to the police, was arrested on suspicion. In his caution statement, he admitted the theft and led the police to his room, where the television set and refrigerator were retrieved. After the police’s preliminary investigation, he was charged and brought before the court.

items.title: Attaque meurtrière en France : « Le terrorisme raciste a frappé » à Trappes
items.description: Un an et demi après l’assassinat d’un coiffeur tunisien , un autre crime probablement raciste plonge la plonge dans l’effroi. Ce vendredi, un homme a tiré à l’arme automatique depuis sa voiture sur la foule à Trappes et La Verrière, dans les Yvelin Ile de France, tuant une personne « d’origine africaine » et blessant au moins quatre autres dont une grièvement « originaire du Maghreb ». Une fillette de 12 ans fait partie des victimes. La piste de l’attaque raciste est retenue et le Parquet national antiterroriste est saisie. Rapidement, l’extrême droite et son discours extrémiste anti-immigration et antimusulman est montrée du doigt. « Les victimes ont été visées pour leur origine, réelle ou supposée. Alors disons les mots : c’est le terrorisme raciste qui a frappé. On a tiré sur des gens pour la couleur de leur peau », a dénoncé la députée écologiste Sabrina Sebaihi. Attaque raciste à Trappes et La Verrière : une personne « d’origine africaine » tuée Un an et demi après Puget-sur-Argens et l’assassinat d’Hichem Miraoui, coiffeur tunisien, le 31 mai 2025, la « haine raciste tue encore », a enchaîné la parlementaire. Cette haine « ne tombe pas du ciel. Elle se nourrit des discours qui, jour après jour, désignent des quartiers, des visages, des prénoms comme des ennemis de l’intérieur », a-t-elle accusé. Selon le maire de Trappes Ali Rabeh, le tireur, Kevin T, 39 ans, a « manifestement tiré au hasard et avait envie de faire un carnage ». « Il y a eu de nombreux tirs à travers différents quartiers de la ville », a-t-il réagi. La personne décédée est d’origine africaine et la personne en urgence absolue est « d’origine maghrébine », a précisé le maire. « Le racisme tue. À Trappes, au moins un mort et quatre blessés graves, parmi lesquels une enfant de 12 ans. Le Parquet national antiterroriste est saisi pour assassinat raciste en lien avec une entreprise terroriste », a dénoncé Jean-Luc Mélenchon, fondateur de La France Insoumise et candidat à la présidentielle de 2027. Cette attaque survient dans un contexte particulièrement tendu marqué par des attaques d’une rare violence contre les personnes d’origine immigrée qui ont culminé cette semaine après les émeutes survenues en marge des manifestations sociales du samedi 17 octobre, et la veille d’une autre journée de mobilisation contre la vie chère demain samedi qui est classée à haut risque. items.title: CBN grants JPMorgan approval-in-principle to establish merchant bank
items.description: By Babajide Komolafe The Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) has granted Approval-in-Principle (AIP) to JPMorgan to establish a merchant bank in Nigeria, to be known as JPMorgan Merchant Bank Nigeria Limited. The proposed establishment of a merchant bank by one of the world’s leading financial institutions marks a significant development for Nigeria’s financial sector, reflecting growing international interest in the country’s financial markets and long-term economic prospects. Announcing the approval, Michael Akuka, Director of the Corporate Communications and Investor Relations Department at the CBN, said the development comes amid sustained reforms aimed at strengthening financial stability, improving market confidence and deepening Nigeria’s integration with global capital markets. The approval follows the successful implementation of the banking sector recapitalisation exercise, which has strengthened the resilience and capacity of the Nigerian banking system. The development comes against the backdrop of the CBN’s broader reform agenda under Governor Olayemi Cardoso, focused on strengthening financial stability, deepening financial markets and rebuilding international confidence in Nigeria’s financial system. Speaking on the Bank’s broader reform priorities, Governor Cardoso said: “Our objective is to build a financial system that is stable, competitive and internationally connected, one that commands confidence and can effectively support investment and economic growth. “We are encouraged by the growing interest of international financial institutions in Nigeria. Our focus remains on sustaining the reforms, strengthening the credibility of our markets and creating an environment in which both domestic and international institutions can participate and thrive.” Akuka clarified that the AIP represents the first stage of the regulatory approval process and does not constitute a final banking licence. JPMorgan Merchant Bank Nigeria Limited must fulfil all applicable regulatory requirements, including incorporation with the Corporate Affairs Commission and completion of the necessary operational and regulatory arrangements, before receiving authorisation to commence business. The CBN has approved the nomination of Mr Adedapo Adedayo Olagunju as Managing Director of the proposed bank. The Bank also approved Latter Kevin George, Nzelu Chinedum Izunwanne and Syed Gabriel Murtaza as Non-Executive Directors. Alade Sarah Omotunde, Ajayi Olukonyinsola and Adetu Seni were also approved as Independent Non-Executive Directors. The proposed bank may commence operations only upon the CBN issuing a final licence. The CBN reaffirmed its commitment to maintaining a sound, competitive and internationally connected financial system that supports sustainable economic growth and expands Nigeria’s participation in global financial markets. items.title: Lahore DC gives formal go-ahead for 3-day Basant festivities in March 2027, outlines conditions and restrictions
items.description: LAHORE: The Lahore deputy commissioner (DC) on Friday gave the formal go-ahead for three-day Basant festivities in the district from March 12-14 next year, outlining guidelines, conditions and restrictions for the celebrations. Basant returned to Lahore earlier this year after an 18-year hiatus, with the passing of the Punjab Regulation of Kite Flying Bill, 2025 by the provincial assembly on December 24, 2025. The legislation authorised deputy commissioners to grant conditional permission for kite-flying — which otherwise remains banned in Punjab — on specified days and at designated locations. In August, Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz announced that the festival would next be celebrated from March 12-14. On Friday, the decision was formalised in notification by the Lahore DC. The notification, a copy of which is available with Dawn , said that kite-flying would be allowed in Lahore during Basant 2027 except at designated prohibited zones and subject to certain conditions. “Kite-flying through the use of permissible kite-flying material, as specified in Schedule-I of the Punjab Regulation of Kite Flying Rules, 2025 and Punjab Kite Flying Regulations, 2025 shall be allowed from March 12-14, 2027,” it added. The notification said the manufacturing of permissible kite-flying material would be allowed from Sept 5, 2026 to March 14, 2027, subject to valid digital registration. Trade, including the purchase, transportation and storage of the material, will be permitted from Feb 1, 2027 to March 14, 2027 while sales to the general public will be allowed from Feb 10, 2027 to March 14, 2027, exclusively through registered sellers. The notification further said that no manufacturer, trader, or seller should manufacture, trade, store or sell permissible kite-flying material unless registered with the deputy commissioner through the government’s eBiz application. “ Patang (kite) shall not exceed four-and-a-half githi (span of a hand) and 35 inches in width and 30 inches in length,” it said. “ Gudda (a large kite) shall not exceed one-and-a-half tawa and 40 inches in width and 34 inches in length,” the notification added. The kite string, known as dor , shall only be wound in the shape of pinna , it must be made of cotton with no more than nine taars (threads) and no fewer than 28 counts and shall be coated with maanjha having a minimum sheesha size of 350 mesh. “Preparation, coating, treatment or processing of dor or maanjha shall be strictly restricted to maya (laundry starch), 350-mesh glass powder and only rice flour, and no other material, chemical, adhesive, hardener, abrasive, metallic substance or strengthening agent, including rema tip top, amri powder or any other material having similar properties or effect, whether used individually or in combination with the permitted material shall be added, mixed or applied at any stage,” the notification said. The DC also prohibited the manufacture, trading, transportation, storage, sale, possession and use of charkhi , sharp maanjha , metallic wire, nylon (plastic) dandi , and any other thread coated with sharp maanjha or any other injurious material. Registered manufacturers, traders and sellers will be required to “conspicuously” display their valid registration certificates at approved premises for kite-flying. “Complete stock, sales and movement records shall be maintained and produced on demand by registered manufacturers, traders and sellers to any authorised officer of the deputy commissioner.” The notification further said that all registered kite-flying associations should comply with the functions assigned under the Punjab Regulation of Kite Flying Rules, 2025 and remain in close coordination with the deputy commissioner and his authorised officers for smooth and safe conduct of kite-flying. Moreover, motorcyclists in Lahore would be required to comply with all the safety measures, including the installation of safety rods, as specified in Chapter-III of the Punjab Kite Flying Regulations 2025 and guidelines issued by the Punjab government secretary and the Home Department under the kite flying law. “All departments, attached departments, agencies and government organisations shall assist the district administration and police for strict compliance of [the] terms and conditions to ensure public safety,” the notification said. According to the notification, kite-flying will not be permitted in the following areas of Lahore during Basant: Aircraft approach path Nadirabad Gulshan Ali Colony Nishat Colony Bhatta Chowk DHA Lahore (blocks R, S, P and Q) Aircraft take-off path Al-Faisal Town Jorraypul Canal Bank Road (adjacent to tajoura) Tajpura Basant had been banned in 2007 because of an increasing number of deaths and serious injuries caused by sharp strings, particularly to motorcyclists and pillion riders, as well as by celebratory gunfire. It was allowed to be celebrated for the first time since then earlier this year, but only in Lahore.

items.title: CONFEMEN : une délégation reçue le président Bassirou Diomaye Faye
items.description: Le président de la République, Bassirou Diomaye Faye, a reçu ce vendredi 23 octobre 2026, une délégation de la Conférence des ministres de l'Éducation des États et gouvernements de la Francophonie (CONFEMEN). La délégation a présenté au chef de l'État, selon une note de la présidence, les résultats du Programme d'analyse des systèmes éducatifs de la CONFEMEN (PASEC), qui est l'une des évaluations de référence de la qualité des apprentissages en Afrique francophone. « Ces travaux donnent aux États un instrument précieux pour mesurer les acquis des élèves, éclairer les choix de politique éducative et mieux répondre aux défis comme aux dynamiques propres à chaque système », renseigne le texte. A lire aussi : Éducation nationale : 99 % des points du protocole d’accord pris en charge selon la tutelle Ainsi, selon la même source, la CONFEMEN a sollicité le président de la République pour porter ce plaidoyer auprès de ses pairs de la CEDEAO et de l'Union africaine. « Cette démarche rejoint une conviction qu'il défend depuis le début de son action, celle qu'aucune transformation économique durable ne se construit sans une école qui forme, qualifie et prépare la jeunesse aux métiers de demain », lit-on dans le texte. Il convient de noter que la Vision Sénégal 2050 place la qualité de l'éducation parmi les conditions de la souveraineté et de la compétitivité du pays, et le Sénégal entend porter cette exigence à l'échelle du continent. items.title: Mondial U17 féminin : les Lioncelles de l’Atlas jouent leur avenir face à l’Argentine
items.description: Dos au mur après leur défaite contre l’Allemagne, les Lioncelles de l’Atlas disputent ce vendredi 23 octobre un match décisif face à l’Argentine lors de la troisième journée du groupe A de la Coupe du monde féminine U17 Maroc-2026. Coup d’envoi à 18h, avec une qualification pour les huitièmes de finale en jeu. Les Lioncelles de l’Atlas n’ont plus le droit à l’erreur. La sélection marocaine féminine U17 affronte l’Argentine, ce vendredi à 18h, pour son dernier match de la phase de groupes du Mondial féminin U17. Une rencontre capitale pour les Marocaines, qui ambitionnent de poursuivre leur parcours dans la compétition disputée à domicile. Après un début de tournoi convaincant, marqué par une large victoire contre la Nouvelle-Zélande (4-0), les joueuses marocaines ont subi un coup d’arrêt face à l’Allemagne, qui s’est imposée sur le score de 4-2 mardi dernier au Complexe Mohammed VI de football. Malgré ce revers, le Maroc conserve la deuxième place du groupe A avec trois points et une différence de buts de +2. L’Argentine compte également trois unités, mais affiche une différence de buts de +1. Cette confrontation directe s’annonce donc déterminante dans la course à la qualification. Les protégées du staff marocain devront retrouver leur efficacité offensive, tout en corrigeant les lacunes défensives observées face aux Allemandes. Soutenues par leur public, elles chercheront à décrocher un résultat leur permettant de poursuivre l’aventure mondiale. De son côté, l’Argentine aborde ce rendez-vous après une défaite contre l’Allemagne (2-1), suivie d’une victoire face à la Nouvelle-Zélande (2-0). La sélection sud-américaine vise elle aussi une place en huitièmes de finale. Le match sera diffusé en direct sur les chaînes et plateformes suivantes : Arryadia TNT, beIN Sports, TOD et FIFA+, en streaming. Pour rappel, la Coupe du monde féminine U17 réunit 24 équipes réparties en six groupes. Les deux premières de chaque groupe ainsi que les quatre meilleures troisièmes se qualifient pour les huitièmes de finale. items.title: Coupe du Faso multisport 2026 : Ouagadougou accueille les premières finales du 24 au 25 octobre
items.description: La directrice générale des Sports et des Loisirs, Valérie Badolo, née Tapsoba, a animé, le mercredi 21 octobre 2026 au stade du 4-Août à Ouagadougou, une conférence de presse consacrée à la première édition de la Coupe du Faso multisport, en compagnie de ses collaborateurs du ministère des Sports, de la Jeunesse et de l’Emploi. A cette occasion, elle a présenté les grandes orientations de cette compétition qui a concern é 11 disciplines sportives, avec des phases finales programmées les 24 et 25 octobre 2026. Le coût global de l’organisation a été estimé à 100 millions de FCFA. Le sport burkinabè a franchi une nouvelle étape avec l’élargissement de la Coupe du Faso à d’autres disciplines que le football. Pour cette première édition, 11 fédérations ont été retenues, notamment celles de l’athlétisme, des sports pour personnes handicapées, du volleyball, du handball, du rugby, de la lutte, de la boxe, de la pétanque, du karaté-do, du taekwondo et du cyclisme. A travers cette initiative, le ministère chargé des Sports a affiché son ambition de diversifier l’offre sportive nationale, de détecter de nouveaux talents et d’améliorer la préparation des athlètes. Le projet a également visé à renforcer la visibilité des disciplines concernées, à promouvoir l’équité sportive et à consolider la cohésion sociale. Interrogé sur le choix des 11 disciplines, le représentant du ministère a expliqué que la sélection s’était appuyée sur plusieurs critères. Il a notamment cité les performances sportives, la gouvernance des instances dirigeantes, la couverture du territoire national, les capacités organisationnelles et le niveau d’inclusion au sein des fédérations. Cette sélection s’est inscrite dans le cadre d’un processus de catégorisation des fédérations, qui n’a pas consisté à établir un classement du premier au dernier, mais à apprécier leurs performances et leurs capacités de fonctionnement. Le ministère a également indiqué que cette première phase pourrait s’étendre à d’autres disciplines lors des prochaines éditions, en fonction des résultats obtenus, des ressources disponibles et des capacités organisationnelles des fédérations. La question du financement a occupé une place importante dans les échanges avec les journalistes. Le coût de cette première édition a été évalué à 100 millions de FCFA, répartis entre les onze fédérations retenues pour assurer l’organisation des compétitions. Face aux préoccupations relatives aux difficultés financières rencontrées par certaines fédérations et au niveau des primes accordées aux athlètes, le ministère a assuré avoir pris des dispositions pour mettre les ressources nécessaires à leur disposition. Les fédérations ont également été invitées à proposer une répartition des primes consacrant au minimum 50 % de l’enveloppe reçue à cette rubrique. Selon les explications fournies à la presse, les propositions ont été transmises au ministère, qui a affirmé suivre leur mise en œuvre. Les récompenses ont été annoncées sous forme de médailles et de primes en numéraire. Les phases finales ont été programmées à Ouagadougou les 24 et 25 octobre 2026. Le ministère a justifié ce choix par le caractère expérimental de cette première édition et par les ressources financières disponibles. L’objectif a été de tirer les enseignements de cette première expérience avant d’envisager une délocalisation de certaines finales dans les régions lors des prochaines éditions. Le calendrier a également tenu compte des contraintes scolaires et du programme sportif national, particulièrement chargé cette année. Après des échanges avec les fédérations, les organisateurs ont retenu cette période, qui a précédé le Tour du Faso. Le ministère a précisé que les compétitions avaient débuté dès le 20 octobre pour certaines disciplines, tandis que les phases finales ont été concentrées sur les 24 et 25 octobre. Les sites de compétition ont été désignés par les fédérations et les programmes ont été regroupés dans un calendrier commun. Les responsables du département ont annoncé leur présence sur les différents sites afin d’accompagner le déroulement des finales. Au cours de la conférence de presse, le ministère a insisté sur le rôle central des fédérations dans la mise en œuvre de cette initiative. Celles-ci ont participé aux réunions préparatoires et aux discussions relatives aux modalités d’organisation des compétitions. Présentées comme les principaux acteurs techniques sur le terrain, elles ont été chargées de contribuer au bon déroulement des épreuves, sous le suivi du ministère. Les organisateurs ont également appelé à une bonne coordination entre les différents intervenants, au respect des règles et à la promotion du fair-play. Pengdwendé Achille OUEDRAOGO

items.title: Bruno Fernandes’ home burgled during Man Utd’s 4-1 defeat to Como
items.description: By Adegboyega Adeleye Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes’ home was burgled while the midfielder was in Italy with his team for their 4-1 Champions League defeat by Como on Wednesday, with police investigating the incident. According to ESPN, Fernandes’ family were not believed to have been at the property when the burglary occurred on Wednesday, October 21. Police attended the scene and Manchester United are supporting their captain. A statement from Cheshire Police, given to ESPN, said officers were called at about 8.30 pm to reports of suspicious activity at an address in the Alderley Park area of Nether Alderley. “The caller reported three unknown men in the rear garden of a neighbouring property,” the statement said. Officers found no trace of the suspects when they arrived but discovered that a burglary had taken place and a number of items had been stolen. “An investigation into the incident has been launched and enquiries are ongoing,” police added. Detective Inspector David Jarvis of Macclesfield Proactive CID said the investigation was at an early stage, adding that officers were working to identify those responsible. Police have appealed to anyone who was in the area at the time and may have witnessed suspicious activity to come forward. They also urged residents with relevant CCTV or dashcam footage to assist the investigation. The burglary came as United endured a difficult spell on the pitch, with their 4-1 defeat to Como extending their winless run to seven matches in all competitions. Fernandes publicly questioned the tactical approach of head coach Michael Carrick after the Champions League loss, saying the decision not to press opponents man-to-man and to leave space behind was a matter for the coaching staff. His comments followed criticism from United defender Lisandro Martínez the previous week, adding to scrutiny of the club’s leadership and performances. Despite the heavy defeat and questions over Carrick’s future, the United manager is expected to remain in charge for Sunday’s Premier League match against Bournemouth, ESPN reported. Fernandes, who was one of United’s standout performers last season, has struggled to reproduce the same form this campaign as the club faces growing pressure to improve its results. items.title: Tope Alabi threatens legal action over online defamation
items.description: By Wasiu Rokibat Popular Nigerian gospel singer Tope Alabi has threatened legal action against individuals who publish, share or circulate statements she considers false and defamatory about her on social media and other platforms. The warning was contained in a public notice issued by her lawyers, Oakmount Legal Practitioners, and shared on the singer’s Instagram page on Friday, October 23, 2026. In the notice, the legal team said the singer, whose full name is Evangelist Patricia Temitope Alabi, had instructed them to take steps to protect her reputation against publications capable of causing damage to her personal, professional and spiritual standing. According to the lawyers, Alabi has spent nearly three decades building a reputation based on integrity, honour and public trust. The notice stated: “Our Client has, for almost thirty (30) years, built a reputation of integrity, honour and public trust in her personal, professional and spiritual life.” The legal team expressed concern over what it described as false, misleading and harmful statements allegedly being circulated about the singer. The lawyers warned that anyone responsible for publishing such statements could face legal consequences, depending on the circumstances and applicable legal provisions. They also cautioned social media users against reposting or forwarding potentially defamatory content, stressing that responsibility may extend beyond the person who originally made the statement. The notice explained that liability could affect “the originator of the statement and to any person who repeats, republishes, reposts, shares, forwards or otherwise amplifies the same,” subject to the facts of each case and any applicable legal defences. The lawyers further warned that operating anonymous or pseudonymous social media accounts would not automatically shield individuals from legal liability. “The use of anonymous, pseudonymous or unverified accounts does not, of itself, confer immunity from legal liability,” the notice stated. As part of the warning, the lawyers directed individuals who had already published material considered defamatory to remove it immediately and refrain from further publication. They stated that deleting a post would not automatically eliminate possible liability for its earlier publication. The legal team also indicated that the singer could seek legal remedies, including damages, injunctions to prevent further publication, court-ordered retractions, public apologies and legal costs. The notice added that the lawyers had been authorised to institute legal proceedings against individuals whose actions gave rise to an actionable claim, without further notice. However, the legal warning clarified that it was not intended to prevent legitimate criticism, truthful statements or the lawful exercise of freedom of expression. The notice stated: “Nothing in this Notice is intended to restrict truthful statements, fair comment on matters of public interest, or the lawful exercise of the right to freedom of expression guaranteed by law.” The message serves as a warning to social media users to exercise caution when making or circulating claims about the singer. Although the legal notice outlined the potential consequences of defamatory publications, it did not identify specific individuals against whom legal proceedings had been initiated. The development highlights the growing concerns surrounding online defamation and the potential legal consequences of publishing or sharing harmful claims about public figures. Tope Alabi, widely known for her gospel music and contributions to Nigeria’s gospel music industry, remains a prominent figure among Christian music lovers. items.title: Rising flour prices fuel weekly inflation
items.description: ISLAMABAD: Short-term inflation rose to 11.85 per cent year-on-year in the week ending October 22, driven largely by wheat flour prices, according to official data released by the Pakistan Bureau of Statistics (PBS) on Friday. The index, which comprises 51 items whose prices are collected from 50 markets in 17 cities, is calculated weekly to track changes in the prices of essential commodities and services. Short-term inflation has remained in double digits for several consecutive weeks, largely on the back of persistent increases in petroleum prices. The data showed that of the 51 essential items monitored during the week, the prices of 19 commodities (37.72pc) increased, while those of 12 items (23.53pc) declined. Meanwhile, the prices of 20 items (39.22pc) remained unchanged from the previous week. The Sensitive Price Index (SPI), which tracks short-term inflation, slightly increased by 0.65pc week-on-week, reflecting price fluctuations in both food and non-food items. Unwilling to ease the petroleum levy , the government has continued to raise petrol and diesel prices on a daily basis. The surge in energy costs is not only fuelling inflationary pressures but also indirectly boosting sales tax collections through higher prices of goods and services. This is cost-push inflation, in which rising energy costs are followed by increases in food prices. As a result, households are under pressure from higher consumer prices. The items whose prices increased the most over the previous week included liquefied petroleum gas (22.44pc), chicken (12.20pc), onions (4.19pc), shirting (1.86pc), plain bread (1.66pc), wheat flour (1pc), garlic (0.74pc), firewood (0.71pc), georgette and one kilogramme of vegetable ghee (0.59pc each), beef (0.31pc) and pulse mash (0.30pc). The items whose prices declined week-on-week included tomatoes (21.99pc), petrol (3.63pc), banana (2.42pc), diesel (1.68pc), potatoes (1.38pc), pulse gram (0.93pc), eggs (0.58pc), powdered milk (0.38pc) and broken rice basmati and sugar (0.35pc each). On an annual basis, the items that recorded the highest price increases included LPG (107.12pc), onions (72.81pc), electricity for Q1 (58.59pc), petrol (44.17pc), diesel (41.56pc), chicken (38.99pc), wheat flour (36.49pc), chilies powder (15.55pc), mutton (14.66pc), beef (12.10pc), bread plain (10.82pc) and tea prepared (8.36pc). In contrast, tomato prices fell by 71.72pc, followed by potatoes (40.75pc), sugar (25pc), eggs (22.14pc), salt powder (14.86pc), pulse masoor (9.08pc), gur (8.98pc) and pulse moong (7.05pc). Last week, short-term inflation rose to 11.38 per cent year-on-year, driven largely by higher food prices , data from PBS showed.

items.title: Melania Trump says secured ceasefire in Ukrainian city of Oleshky
items.description: US First Lady Melania Trump said in a surprise announcement Friday she had secured a localized ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine in the ravaged city of Oleshky, where citizens are trapped and short of food. The localized ceasefire in Russian-occupied Oleshky would begin on October 29, a statement issued by her office said. There was no immediate confirmation from Moscow or Kyiv. “The situation in Oleshky is dire. Oleshky is a front-line war city on the brink of disaster,” Melania, the wife of President Donald Trump, said in the statement. “It was abundantly clear that without my intervention, the possibility to bring humanitarian aid into the city and to evacuate the elderly would be impossible.” The announcement comes a year after the Slovenian-born former model stunned the world by revealing she had established a back channel of communication with Russian President Vladimir Putin. Melania Trump has since secured the “reunifications” of 34 children separated from their parents by the war, her office said. In a number of cases they had been abducted by Russia. Her announcement also comes as President Trump has stepped up efforts to end Moscow’s war on Ukraine — largely by pivoting back towards Putin and away from Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky. Melania Trump said she had worked with the Russian and Ukrainian leaderships on the Oleshky plan, and that civilian leaders from both countries would “work together” and visit the devastated city to assess aid needs. – Caught in the crossfire – “Residents who wish to evacuate will receive coordinated support and transportation to their preferred destination. I anticipate some will want to go to Russia, and some to Ukraine,” she said. She added that she an “impartial American media organization” — which she did not identify — would “accompany and document Russian and Ukrainian teams on the ground throughout the process” to ensure residents’ wishes were respected. Oleshky, on the southern bank of the Dnipro River in the Kherson region, was seized by Russian troops in 2022. The population has dropped from about 24,000 before Russia invaded to around 2,000 today. Former residents of the city told AFP earlier this month that people there were caught in the crossfire between Russia and Ukraine and facing worsening shortages of food and medication. The 56-year-old First Lady carefully guards her image and is an infrequent presence at the White House, preferring to stay in New York where her son Barron is studying. But she has ramped up her public profile in recent months, launching a series of initiatives, including one to help older foster children and another to tackle online harassment. Last week Melania Trump unveiled a women’s health program in a press conference in the White House Rose Garden alongside her husband, who lavished praise on her. In January she released a documentary movie called “Melania” giving a manicured view of her husband’s return to power. The film was funded by a multimillion-dollar deal with Amazon.
